Discussed uses of oxygen as a non-metal.
Child gave examples: respiration in living things, hospital oxygen cylinders, and burning.
Explained that rockets carry oxygen because space lacks air for combustion.
Teach-back was not completed.
end.parentNote: Asha practised identifying uses of oxygen through everyday examples, including breathing, medical oxygen, burning, and rocket engines. Pari connected each use to an observed situation and explained why oxygen is needed for burning in space. The lesson ended before a teach-back check; at home, ask Pari to name three uses of oxygen and explain one in one sentence.
